summary.outcome: Initialization and Wave 1 were started — 2 agents spawned in parallel for plans 21-01 (Pinning Provider Abstraction) and 21-02 (CID Registration & Advisory Quota). The transcript ends mid-execution before Wave 1 completed.

repo: Phase 21 branch is `docs/phase-21-context`, containing prior context/planning work alongside execution.
Phase 21 has 7 plans across 4 waves: Wave 1 (SDK + API foundations), Wave 2 (client wiring), Wave 3 (Settings UI + TEE backend), Wave 4 (migration UI + benchmarks).
BYO IPFS node support uses a lightweight API footprint: users pin directly to their own node and notify CipherBox via CID registration rather than uploading through CipherBox.
SDK pinning abstraction supports two providers: KuboProvider (Kubo RPC) and PsaProvider (IPFS Pinning Service API) with protocol auto-detection and CORS validation.
workflow: GSD orchestrator stays on the existing phase branch rather than creating a new one when a matching branch already exists.
Wave descriptions are derived from plan objectives before spawning — 'what this builds and why' improves handoff clarity to subagents.
